videoEditEncoder.unsupported: This device can't encode video with the selected settings. Switch to software encoding or H.264, or lower the resolution, then try again.
videoEditEncoder.stalled: The video encoder stopped making progress and was stopped. Switch to software encoding or H.264 and try again; if it keeps happening, update your graphics driver.
videoEditEncoder.failed: The video encoder failed and was stopped. Switch to software encoding or H.264 and try again; if it keeps happening, update your graphics driver.

persistence.newer-version: This {{format}} was created by a newer Henji AI. Update the app to open it.
persistence.unsupported-version: This {{format}} predates the oldest format this version can read and cannot be opened. The original file was not changed.
persistence.migration-failed: Could not upgrade {{format}} (step {{from}} → {{to}}). The original file was not changed. Backup: {{backup}}
persistence.invalid-content: This {{format}} uses content that this version cannot open. The original file was not changed.
persistence.corrupt: This {{format}} is damaged and its content cannot be parsed. The original file was not changed.
persistence.backup-unavailable: Backup was not completed. No upgrade was attempted.
persistence.backup-failed: Could not back up {{format}} before upgrading. No upgrade was attempted and the original file was not changed. Check folder permissions and free space.

messages.generationInterrupted: The previous generation was interrupted before the task was fully submitted and cannot continue. Please start it again.
